Correction to the HX-2 hole-transport layer preprint

Correction: the authors of the HX-2 preprint report that the 24.0% value used an aperture smaller than the active area. Remeasured with a calibrated mask, the champion HX-2 cell reached 22.1%, within error of the reference cells. The claimed efficiency gain from HX-2 does not hold.

This correction supersedes the efficiency values in the preprint.

Independent replication of PV-7 cell efficiency

Abstract: A second laboratory followed the published PV-7 recipe and cell stack. Under AM1.5G illumination at 25 °C with a calibrated mask, the best of 40 cells reached 17.9% and the median was 16.2%.

Conditions: the same as the original report. The replicating group could not reproduce the 21.4% value.
